thread:
Asha: Tiny milestone update 10 years at Redwood today :tada: and we also closed on a new place this morning :house_with_garden: Feeling very grateful and thought I:d share. No big speech, but if anyone wants to drop 1 line for a card or swing by the kitchen for coffee at 3pm, I;d love that.

Liam: 10 YEARS?! Absolute legend, Asha. Huge congrats on the house too :confetti_ball: Count me for coffee at 3.

Priya: Wow wow wow!!! 10 years at Redwood :star2: and new keys :house: That;s such great news. I can bring a mini cake. What flavor? React below.

Omar: Huge congrats :raised_hands: I;ll bring a card. Can we get a small banner? I have a spare "Congrats" one.

Bea: Love this. I;ll make a quick slideshow of ugly throwback photos (team event bloopers) to embarrass you for 30s.

Asha: Hah please yes Bea. Cake poll (react): 

🍫 chocolate
🍓 raspberry
🍋 lemon
🥟 vanilla

Liam: 🍫

Priya: 🥟

Omar: 🍋

Bea: 🍓 (for the photos)

Asha: Looks like chocolate + vanilla tie. Maybe half/half cupcakes?

HR Bot: Event created: https://calendar.company.internal/e/1945678901-asha-10yr-house (Today  3:00pm Kitchen) :calendar: Please RSVP.

Priya: I;ll order a dozen assorted cupcakes and swing by at 2:50 to set up.

Omar: I;ll hang the banner and bring some balloons. Someone grab a marker for the card.

Bea: Slideshow ready :clapper: 3:05pm shock-and-awe.

Asha: You;re all the best. If anyone wants to add a one-liner for the card, drop it here and I;ll tape it in.

Liam: "Asha ;10 years of brilliance, mentorship, and patience. Congrats on the house!"

Priya: "So proud of you. Here;s to the next decade of wins and home-cooked meals."

Omar: "10 years at Redwood and a new front door? You;re unstoppable. Congrats!"

Bea: "Congrats Asha ; can't wait to see the new place. Also sorry in advance for the slideshow."

Asha: Thank you all :heart: See you at 3pm :)
